calls.title: Meet with Rippling Support
calls.summary: The team convened to address the correction of Christopher Samuel Newton's EIN and legal name details in Rippling, ensuring that the updates align with IRS requirements for accurate 1099 form generation. Justice Straub led the decision to revert Chris's EIN to the previous version and update his profile to reflect sole proprietorship status, while confirming the addition of his legal middle name. The effective date for these changes is set to October 1st to accommodate the October pay run. The team plans to execute a payroll correction run with a nominal $20 correction fee, avoiding any monetary changes to payments. Future management strategies were discussed to prevent similar issues, including preemptive 1099 form previews. Clear communication will be maintained throughout the correction process, with updates coordinated between Justice and Jennifer.

calls.title: Meet with Rippling Support
calls.summary: The meeting focused on correcting payroll records for a contractor who had an incorrect employer identification number (EIN). Jennifer confirmed the contractor's tax classification as S corp, clarifying that no 1099 NEC form would be issued. The team decided to zero out the incorrect payment and create an off-cycle payroll run while confirming a $20 fee only applicable to payroll corrections. Expectations for status updates on payroll corrections were set, with corrections moving to paid status by 2:30 PM PST and 1099 previews refreshing every 20-25 days. Step-by-step instructions were provided on how to handle the payroll app for corrections effectively, emphasizing the need for clear record-keeping and compliance with tax regulations regarding S corps.
